annotation.bound_parties_text: The Illinois Department of Transportation and other state agencies are directed to lead the initiative, and entities voluntarily participating in the testing program must register, certify compliance and observe the Order's requirements.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Participating entities may implement legal testing programs under the Program immediately after providing notification to IDOT and shall observe the requirements listed in this Executive Order.
annotation.dates_quote: This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon filing with the Secretary of State.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: EXECUTIVE ORDER ESTABLISHING THE AUTONOMOUS ILLINOIS INITIATIVE
